diagnostics.message: aws_cloudfront_distribution.default serves content from the S3 origin bucket created by aws_s3_bucket.origin (its origin domain_name resolves via local.bucket_domain_name to that bucket). The bucket must exist before the distribution is created — the source explicitly declares `depends_on = ["aws_s3_bucket.origin"]` for this reason, but no dependency (implicit or explicit) is recorded in the graph, so Terraform could create the distribution before its origin bucket exists.

aws_s3_bucket_policy.default attaches its policy to the S3 bucket named by local.bucket, which is the bucket created by aws_s3_bucket.origin (when var.origin_bucket is empty). The graph only records a dependency on data.template_file.default, so the policy resource could be applied before the bucket exists, which fails. Wiring an actual reference to aws_s3_bucket.origin into the bucket argument (as local.bucket effectively does) establishes the ordering implicitly.
